title: Chart quiz #19
caption:
Chart quiz #19. No peeking at the reveal.

Q1: What does the volume say?
Q2: Continue, or reverse?
Q3: Where does the stop go?

Each chart pauses so you can comment your answer, then plays on to show what happened, and why.

Tell me your score: 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Practise reading charts at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.

#MemeStreet #ChartQuiz #Volume #BullFlag #LearnToTrade
narration: Three charts. Three new skills to test. Volume, flags and stops. Question one. Price broke above resistance. Look at the volume bars. Does the volume confirm the move, or warn against it? It confirms it. Volume more than doubled on the breakout candles. Lots of traders joined the move, and it kept going. Question two. A sharp rally, then a quiet drift lower on light volume. Does the move continue, or reverse? It reversed. It looked like a bull flag, but the drift kept going and broke the pole's base. Patterns fail too, which is why you'd use a stop. Question three. You just bought this bounce off support. Where does the stop go? A, B, or C? C, just below the swing low. A gets hit by an ordinary dip, and B risks far too much. Below the swing low is where your idea is proven wrong. How many did you get? Tell me your score in the comments. Practise on real charts from the game, at memestreet.net.
